description: Nigeria National Electricity Demand Timeseries [2016] is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Oluwadamilola Oluwole. To allow for a proper assessment of the reliability contribution of renewables on any grid, it is imperative that the electricity demand is reflective of actual consumption. Historical national demand time series profiles are not publicly available from Nigeria’s transmission system operator; therefore, a long-term demand profile had to be developed. Coverage: national (NG); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
